segments.contextAfter: One or more `kTweenData` atoms that contain the data for the tween atom. Each `kTweenData` atom can contain different data to be processed by the tween component, and a tween component can process data from only one `kTweenData` atom a time. For example, an application can use a list tween to animate sprites. The `kTweenEntry` atom for the tween atom could contain three sets of animation data, one for moving the sprite from left to right, one for moving the sprite from right to left, and one for moving the sprite from top to bottom. In this case, the `kTweenEntry` atom for the tween atom would contain three `kTweenData` atoms, one for each data set. The application specifies the desired data set by specifying the ID of the `kTweenData` atom to use.
